evidence.summary: Prebuilt debug library missing source-declared mncs_session_composite_types.
Built selected CLI/embed with Cargo, then native Commons lookup succeeded.

reproduction.summary: Selected Language source exports mncs_session_composite_types, but its prebuilt debug embed lacked that symbol. Commons pressure lookup failed until an isolated rebuild. Forge status hashes identify artifact bytes, not build origin.

workaround.description: Build isolated selected compiler/embed and bind exact paths; no ambient runtime fallback.
